item.title: Fire response activated along Table Mountain’s Pipe Track
item.description: Firefighters are working together to control a fire that started near the Pipe Track hiking area on Table Mountain. The fire is located above Imizamo Yethu in Hout Bay, and officials have quickly deployed both ground and air resources to respond to the situation, Cape {town}Etc reports.
